auto.k_56618da8c832: [EN] Nasheara Handmade Tiles has been active since 2012 with the goal of designing and producing traditional and decorative Iranian tiles. With expertise in traditional tile-making techniques and a deep appreciation for Persian art, we provide consultation, design, production, supply and installation services for wall, floor and outdoor tiles. Nasheara Tiles has successfully executed numerous projects in residential complexes, restaurants and cultural spaces. Our mission is to reconnect traditional Iranian tile art with contemporary architecture through high-quality, durable and beautiful designs.

atelier.heroSub: For three decades we have kept Persian patterns alive in glaze and clay — for walls, floors and spaces with character.
atelier.swatchLead: Touch a swatch — the tile, its name and material appear on the wall.

atelier.featuredLead: Patterns that speak of hand, glaze and kiln.
atelier.collectionsTitle: From floor to wall to courtyard
atelier.casesLead: Every project is the story of a space.
atelier.studioLead: Every tile is painted by hand and fired in a kiln; no two pieces are alike, no surface repeats.
atelier.articlesLead: Notes on glaze, care and choosing a pattern.
atelier.contactLead: For a project, a renovation or a pattern choice, ask us anything.
atelier.footerAbout: A handmade tile atelier keeping Persian patterns alive in clay and glaze for contemporary walls and floors.
